接口 GradeSubmissionService

所有已知实现类:
AccessGradeSubmissionService, InMemoryGradeSubmissionService
public interface GradeSubmissionService
教学班成绩草稿的保存与读取接口。审核和正式成绩写入将在后续阶段补充。
